## BA-OCAD: Backdoor Attack Against One-Class Sequential Anomaly Detection Models

**BA-OCAD** is a backdoor attack framework for one-class sequential anomaly detection models such as Deep SVDD and OC4Seq. It uses trigger generation and backdoor injection to allow anomalies to evade detection while maintaining benign performance.
